descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: Use when the task says to look at, examine, or inspect an object under a desklamp or floorlamp (e.g. "look at the alarmclock under the desklamp"). Not for moving objects.
descriptions.pick_and_place: Use for a plain move of ONE object to a destination (e.g. "put a mug on the desk", "move keys to the safe") with no clean/wet, heat/hot, cool/cold word and no count of two. Default for simple moves.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: Use when the task says to clean (clean, cleaned, wash, wet) an object and then put it somewhere, e.g. "put a clean plate in the cabinet". Uses a sinkbasin. One object.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: Use when the task says to cool, chill, cold, or refrigerate an object then place it, e.g. "put a cold apple on the table". Uses the fridge. One object.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: Use when the task says to heat, warm, hot, or cook an object then place it, e.g. "put a hot potato on the countertop". Uses the microwave. One object.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: Use when the task says "two" or gives a count of objects to put somewhere, e.g. "put two pillows on the sofa". Choose this over pick_and_place whenever two items are required.
